cpu_scope: GBA timers2+3 measure sound_update CPU calls under mGBA. DMA stalls during calls included; DMA bus traffic outside those calls excluded. Driver architecture is unchanged from Round2 stereo-DMA benchmark. No physical-hardware timing measurement.
audio_source: Actual output of the compiled GBA ROM in mGBA 0.10.5, with no capture gain/EQ/fades. Source PCM is16384Hz,8-bit stereo.
